content.talk_track: We cannot accept the litter structure as offered: 2,000 units in 90 days has a probability of under 0.1% on our forecast, so the 20% marketing support is not something we can count. On its own, the 15.0% base is 7.0 points short of the 22.0% we need. Our first counter is to set the target at 250 units in 90 days, which we reach with a probability of 60.5%. If you prefer to keep the 2,000-unit target, we would need the margin guaranteed at 22.0% instead.
content.email_paragraph: On the cat litter, we are not able to accept a 20% marketing bonus that depends on 2,000 units in 90 days, since our forecast gives that a probability of under 0.1%. We would be glad to proceed if the target is set at 250 units in 90 days, or if the base margin is guaranteed at 22.0%.
